_howto: Elections this app knows about. `current` is the default for every API call and for adapter results that don't name an election. Each entry: key (stable, used in ?election=), name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), and optionally `races` = the config file listing which states hold which races (used only for states with no live source). Adding an election never removes an older one: its snapshots stay queryable with ?election=<key>.
